# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5293

# Review — PAN-5293
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — `tests/e2e/styleguide-conformance.spec.ts` still polls the removed `command-deck-tree-title`, so CI test-shard 4/4 stays red

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5293-review-bc1714ff
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5293/.pan/review/agent-pan-5293-review-bc1714ff/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5293 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5293
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5332
- HEAD reviewed: bc1714ff892491ca2344c53917789ca6236579de
- Base / prior cycle: merge-base eeeb0a7811642d2fa89dc48214427d4d2eee29b6. The prior cycle reviewed 701710bf (run agent-pan-5293-review-701710bf). That report was written, but its verdict was never signalled. This cycle re-checks its findings.

Since 701710bf there are two commits: `12a4b8d1a2a` (harness-branch baseline row, no-loss audit successor) and `bc1714ff` (continue file). The product code has not changed, so the first cycle's full code review still applies. I re-verified it below.

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] The style-guide e2e still expects the deck tree title that no longer renders — `tests/e2e/styleguide-conformance.spec.ts:541-545`
- Severity: ! (a CI test job fails on the PR; the CI test job is the project's verification test gate)
- Classification / requirement scope: The implementation missed a dependent test. in_pr_scope.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: The only `<ProjectNode>` mount left is `components/frame/IssuesSection.tsx`, line 46, and it uses `variant="frame"`. The frame header has no `data-testid="command-deck-tree-title"`. That id exists only in the tree-variant branch of `ProjectNode.tsx`, which nothing mounts now. The spec opens `/command-deck`, runs `getByTestId('command-deck-tree-title').first()` and polls for a count of 1.
- Expected / observed / impact: On CI at 701710bf, `test-shard (4/4)` failed with `expected +0 to be 1` at line 543, after one retry. Commit `12a4b8d1a2a` fixed the other two CI failures but did not touch this spec or `ProjectNode`. The failure is deterministic, so it still reproduces at bc1714ff. The font contract for this surface is also unchecked.
- Evidence: CI job 132766113745 (run 43699096531). `grep -rn command-deck-tree-title src tests` now matches only the spec and the unmounted tree branch. CI for bc1714ff was still pending when I wrote this report.
- Fix: Move the font assertion to a surface that still renders, such as the left column's Issues eyebrow (`issues-section-toggle`) or the project switcher name (`project-switcher`). Assert the font the style guide sets for that element. Do not put the dead test id back just to satisfy the spec.

## Resolved since the prior cycle
- **`lint:harness-branches` (conversationMeta.ts):** fixed. `scripts/harness-branches-baseline.txt` adds the row `1 …/conversationMeta.ts` in commit `12a4b8d1a2a`, which references PAN-5293 and explains why. The PRD rule F-D15 is a display rule for the default harness, so a baseline row is reasonable.
- **`tests/unit/dashboard/no-loss-audit.test.ts` importing the deleted Sidebar:** fixed. The case now checks the successors: `LeftColumn`, `LeftNav`, `WorkspacesSection` and `workspaceRows.sortWorkspaces`.

## Non-blocking Findings
- `~` **Stale user docs outside the PRD's list.** Classification: validation gap, whole_feature_scope.
  - `concepts.mdx` (lines 19, 24, 27) still describes the "Awareness rail" and the "project and conversation sidebar".
  - `cli/overview.mdx` (lines 12, 17) does the same.
  - Both describe UI that this PR removes. WI-24 and WI-25 did not list these files. Update them to the left column and the `/activity` Feed tab.
- `~` **The left column goes stale off the deck.** Classification: validation gap, in_pr_scope. `useAgentSetInvalidation` and the `overdeck:reconnected` → `invalidateQueries()` handler still live only in `CommandDeck/index.tsx`. Off the deck, the left column's issue list catches up only on the 30 s `['command-deck-projects']` refetch or the session-tree stream. Consider moving both into `DeckDataHost`.
- `~` **Footer overflow.** At 264 px in a source checkout, the footer `?` button sits on or past the column's right edge, because the row uses `flex-nowrap`. See `docs/screenshots/pan-5293/drawer-800-open.png`.
- `?` **Pane focus after a create on the deck.** When "New conversation" runs from the left column while the deck is open, there is no `onCreated` to prime `appliedConvId`. The deck's deep-link effect then applies the new `convId` again once the conversation enters the list (≤10 s), which can take focus back from another pane.
- `?` **`FeatureItem.test.tsx` and the CI subset.** The file changed (+93) but is not in the CI subset on main or here, so the new collapsed-row cases (WI-12) run only by hand. Its grouped-menu case fails on this branch and on the merge-base checkout alike, so that failure predates this PR. `FeatureItem.pullRequest.test.tsx` and `FeatureItem.linkedConversation.test.tsx` are in the subset and pass (4/4).
- `?` **Unrelated CI timeout.** `tests/unit/lib/vault/two-machine.e2e.test.ts` timed out at 5 s in shard 1/4 at 701710bf. No vault code changed; it is most likely a flake.
- **Housekeeping:**
  - `scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt` keeps the row `1019 …/components/Sidebar.tsx` for a deleted file.
  - `src/dashboard/frontend/tests/pan-5289-work-dock.spec.ts:46` seeds the retired `overdeck.ui.awarenessCollapsed` key.
  - `workspaceRows.ts` keeps a stale comment about a "Projects entry (Main checkout)".
  - 12 PNGs (~1.4 MB) are committed under `docs/screenshots/pan-5293/`; the PRD put them in `.tmp/` plus the PR description.
- **Stub-UI scanner hits:** all are mitigated. Every flagged state has a writer (`setOpen`, `setMoreOpen`, `toggleCollapsed`, `setDrawerOpen`). `DeckDataHost` returns `null` by design: it is the one owner of the session-tree subscription (F-D4, NFR-2).

## Coverage
**Changed-file ledger.**
- **Reviewed, frame and deck:** `App.tsx`, `App/AppChrome.tsx`, `App/AppRoutes.tsx`, every file in `components/frame/` and `components/frame/deck/`.
- **Reviewed, Command Deck:** `CommandDeck/index.tsx` (compared with main), `ConversationList.tsx`, `ConversationRow.tsx`, `conversationMeta.ts`, `modelLabels.ts`, `ProjectTree/FeatureItem.tsx`, `featureRowMeta.ts`, `ProjectNode.tsx`. I also diffed `useIssueSessionActions.ts` against main's handler block: the only differences are the intended `deckKey`/`openInDeck`/`useDeckDialogs` substitutions and the removal of `handleSelectProject`/`handleSelectConversation`, which `useOpenConversation` replaces.
- **Reviewed, other source:** `ActivityPanel.tsx`, `ActivityFeedTab.tsx`, `NeedsYouIndicator.tsx`, `MachinesNavItem.tsx`, `CommandPalette.tsx`, `lib/commandDeckSelection.ts`, `lib/experimentalFeatures.ts`, `lib/selectors/issueIndex.ts`.
- **Reviewed, deletions:** `Sidebar.tsx`, `IssuesPaneFilterRow.tsx`, `NewConversationSplitButton.tsx`, the Sidebar tests (deleted-subject exemption, with replacements in `frame/__tests__`), and `command-deck.module.css`. I checked every removed class for a remaining `styles.<name>` reference and found none.
- **Reviewed, tests and scripts:** every new or changed unit test (run), the Playwright spec diffs (`command-deck-resource-strip`, `pan-4201-issue-tree`, `pan2450-pipeline-overview`, `pan2464-machine-room`, the new `pan-5293-left-column`), `tests/unit/dashboard/no-loss-audit.test.ts`, `scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt`, `scripts/circular-deps-baseline.txt`, `scripts/harness-branches-baseline.txt`.
- **Reviewed, docs:** the added lines in every `configuration/*.mdx` file in the diff (effort, issue-trackers, knowledge, linked-machines, projects, remote-access, workspaces), plus `features/*.mdx`, `anywhere.mdx`, `introduction.mdx`, `quickstart.mdx`, `reference/lanes.mdx`, the developer docs, `CLAUDE.md` and the changelog. `reference/workers.mdx` has no sidebar or Awareness wording, so it needs no change.
- **Not applicable:** the `.pan/*` plan artifacts. The PNGs were inspected (light conversation view, 800 px drawer, footer crops).

**Dimensions.**
- **Correctness:** I checked the `openInDeck` action rules, the selection store with the `CommandDeck` unmount cleanup (F-D1), the single owners of `N`, `[`, the `/handoff` listener and the session-tree subscription, and the create and open handlers against main. No product-code defect. The open blocker is the stale e2e.
- **Security:** no new trust boundary. The fetch targets and the confirmation flows moved verbatim.
- **Performance and NFR-3:** every `refetchInterval`/`setInterval` among the added lines is moved code on an existing query key: projects 30 s, conversations 10 s, workspace registry 10 s, costs 15 s, container poll 5 s. There is no new key or interval. The container poll and the tree subscription now run on every route, as F-D4 accepts. Per-row selectors return primitives and use the memoized issue index. App gains no store subscription.
- **Requirements/UX:** the manifest has no item-level acceptance criteria (`acceptanceCriteria: []`), so the matrix covers the PRD's AC-1 to AC-8. I respected all eight NonGoals; the PipelineView, God View, Board, Flywheel and Order Book pages are untouched.

**Acceptance criteria.**

| AC | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | Met | No `Sidebar` import or render remains; `components/Sidebar.tsx` is deleted. |
| AC-2 | Met | `CommandDeck.test.tsx`, lines 772–773. The Awareness mount is removed. |
| AC-3 | Met (unit) | The `App.test.tsx` case for FR-3. The Playwright checklist exists but runs only against a seeded dashboard, so it is unverified on CI. |
| AC-4 | Met | `NewConversationButton.test.tsx`. `N` is registered once. |
| AC-5 | Met | `ActivityFeedTab.test.tsx`, `ActivityPanel.test.tsx`. |
| AC-6 | Met | `AppChrome.test.tsx`, lines 133 and 137; `App.test.tsx`, line 596. |
| AC-7 | Met, with a caveat | New and changed tests are in the subset, and the subset-list test passes. `FeatureItem.test.tsx` is outside the subset, as it was on main. |
| AC-8 | Partly met | Typecheck passes (`overdeck/test`), and the author reports `npm run lint` passes locally. The CI test gate is red: shard 4/4 fails on the style-guide e2e. The screenshots exist (12 in `.tmp/pan-5293-screens/`). |

## Verification
- **CI at 701710bf** (run 43699096531): `lint-group (core)`, `test-shard (1/4)` and `test-shard (4/4)` failed. Two of those causes are now fixed; the style-guide e2e is not. **CI at bc1714ff:** the jobs were pending when I wrote this; `overdeck/test` passes.
- **Focused Vitest, 28 files** (frame, deck, CommandDeck, App, ActivityPanel and others): 403 passed, 1 failed. The failing `FeatureItem.test.tsx` grouped-menu case also fails on the merge-base checkout.
- **Focused Vitest, this cycle:** `FeatureItem.pullRequest.test.tsx` and `FeatureItem.linkedConversation.test.tsx`, 4/4 passed. `frontend-test-subset-list.test.ts`, 2/2 passed.
- **Lints run locally in the prior cycle (same product code):** `lint:file-size`, `lint:circular`, `lint:effect-diagnostics` (none new), and all the later core steps (docs, ratchet-audit, effect-facades, source-introspection and others) pass. `lint:harness-branches` now passes from committed state.
- **Not run:** the full test suite (CI owns it), the e2e style-guide spec locally (CI already showed the failure, and the code it checks is unchanged), and live Playwright.
